description.narrative: Provide technical support to the NOC, legal and technical task forces to review and update national regulations relating to the national ODS regulatory framework to be consistent with the unified GCC regulations, and standards for mandatory leak detection and RRR; review and update the BAYAN e licensing system; train 20 customs and environmental inspectors; provide six refrigerant identifiers for customs and environment inspectors; and develop and implement public awareness campaigns to promote the RRR network and the minimum leakage initiative; revise and update training curricula for good practices in servicing; develop specifications for use and installation of equipment containing flammable refrigerants; establish the training network (six sets of training equipment provided to vocational training institutes); train 400 service technicians; certify 175 service technicians and provide them with service tools as incentive; conduct an awareness workshop on emerging technologies for 50 end-users; and a study to promote the minimum-leakage programme including development of a multi language manual for installation of equipment and a specialized website for the updated national codes of service practice; develop guidelines for the RRR of refrigerants; conduct a study on the business models to enhance the network
